scripts.prepare-web: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); ['index.html', 'styles.css', 'app.js', 'data.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); console.log('Copied web assets to www/');"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build: npm run prepare-web && npx cap copy
